pages.task: A gauge reads −0.6 bar, and atmospheric is 1 bar. What is the absolute pressure, in bar?
pages.why: Atmospheric + gauge is 1 + (−0.6). Adding a negative steps down the line, so 0.6 down from 1 is 0.4 bar, less than the air around.

pages.text: A calculator like this one has two minus keys. [(−)] makes a number negative, and [−] takes one number away from another. So −3 − 2 is keyed [(−)] 3 [−] 2.

pages.name: Key in −3
pages.task: Key in −3, then Check, as you would press = on your own calculator.
pages.why: [(−)] is the sign key, so [(−)] 3 makes 3 negative. [−] is for taking one number away from another, as in 5 − 3.

pages.text: Keyed as [(−)] 4 [x²], the calculator squares the 4 first and gives −16. To square −4 itself, put it in brackets, [(] [(−)] 4 [)] [x²], and you get 16.

pages.name: Square a reading
pages.task: A formula needs u², and the reading u is −4. Key in u² so the calculator gives 16.
pages.why: Brackets round −4 make the calculator square the whole reading, (−4) × (−4) = 16. Without them it squares the 4 and then makes it negative, −16.

pages.task: Counting ahead as plus, a ship goes from 1 m/s ahead to 3 m/s astern. What is its change in velocity, in m/s?
pages.why: Counting ahead as plus, initial is 1 and final is −3. Final − initial is (−3) − 1, one step further down from −3, so −4 m/s. Key it as [(−)] 3 [−] 1.

pages.task: Another gauge reads −0.35 bar. With atmospheric at 1 bar, what is the absolute pressure?
pages.why: Atmospheric + gauge is 1 + (−0.35). Adding a negative steps down, so 0.35 down from 1 is 0.65 bar, less than the air around, as it should be.

pages.alt: The formula 2 times u squared, with u in a slot, and u equals minus 3 beneath it. Minus 3 has gone into the slot, in brackets. Squared first: equals 2 times 9. Equals 18.
pages.name: Square in a formula
pages.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 340 200" width="340" style="fill:#1d1f22;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start" height="200"><style>.s0{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:5.25px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:21px;font-weight:700;paint-order:stroke}.s1{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:5.25px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:21px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke}</style><g><text x="111.67" y="50" text-anchor="start" class="s0">2</text><text x="134.90" y="50" text-anchor="start" class="s0">×</text><g><rect x="161.15" y="29" width="55.50" height="27" rx="5" style="fill:#fbe29a"/><text x="188.91" y="50" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">(−3)</text></g><text x="211.66" y="50" text-anchor="start" class="s0">²</text><text x="188.91" y="82" text-anchor="middle" style="fill:#0b6a70;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:3.5px;stroke-linejoin:round;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:middle;paint-order:stroke">u = −3</text><text x="87.42" y="128" text-anchor="start" class="s0">=</text><text x="111.67" y="128" text-anchor="start" class="s0">2</text><text x="134.90" y="128" text-anchor="start" class="s0">×</text><g><text x="165.97" y="128" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">9</text></g><text x="87.42" y="176" text-anchor="start" class="s0">=</text><g><text x="123.03" y="176" text-anchor="middle" class="s1">18</text></g></g><g/></svg>
pages.task: A formula has 2u² in it, and u is −3. What is 2u²?
pages.why: Put −3 in its slot in brackets, 2 × (−3)². Powers come before times, so (−3)² = 9 first, then 2 × 9 = 18.

pages.name: Key the change
pages.task: Counting ahead as plus, a ship goes from 5 m/s astern to 2 m/s ahead. Key in its change in velocity.
pages.why: Counting ahead as plus, initial is −5 and final is 2. Final − initial is 2 − (−5) = 7 m/s. Key it as 2 [−] [(−)] 5, the take-away key and then the sign key.
